overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee met to review proposed technical and procedural cleanup amendments to the Medford Zoning Ordinance and to discuss updates to the draft vacant building ordinance.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Technical and Procedural Cleanup
items.summary: The committee discussed a list of copy edits, formatting updates, and changes to definitions regarding buildings, structures, and dwellings, ultimately voting to keep the matter in committee to allow staff to compile the edits into structured tiers.

items.title: Proposed Vacant Building Ordinance
items.summary: The committee reviewed revisions to the proposed ordinance, including definitions of local property management, tiered registration fees for larger commercial properties, and expanded enforcement discretion. The motion to refer the item to a regular City Council meeting pending legal review and further edits was approved.
